narrative.offerRewardText: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
narrative.requestItemsText:
The tears of the Fire Lord are a rare find indeed.

Offer 1 Blood of the Mountain and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.
